The authority state is **MULTIPLE_GOVERNING** across two distinct scopes:

* **SE-0325** governs the new SwiftPM plugin entry point (`swiftpm-plugin-entry-point`), superseding the previous protocol entry point defined in SE-0303.
* **SE-0303** governs the retained legacy plugin API (`swiftpm-plugin-legacy-api`), which remains active so existing plugins continue to function.
